lines.en: I hop down the corridor on one leg.

lines.zh: 钩子在地板上划出声音
lines.en: My hook scores the floor.

lines.zh: 我的身体一前一后地摆
lines.en: My body rocks forward and back.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，像在赶时间
lines.en: I move urgently, like one running late.

lines.zh: 我的披风被门框挂住，扯断了
lines.en: My cape snags the door frame and tears.
I lower my head and push forward.

lines.zh: 我每跳一步，地板就响一次
lines.en: Each hop rings the floor once.
My hook peels the wall.
I never move in a straight line.
I hop faster than I look.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在拐角处滑了一下
lines.en: My foot slides at the corner.

lines.zh: 我跳过一堆倒下的椅子
lines.en: I hop over a heap of fallen chairs.
I stand in the doorway, head cocked.
My hook hangs at my side.
The hook hand is out.
I raise the hook and look at it.
I do not breathe, but I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我的披风破得只剩一半
lines.en: My cape is torn to half.
I am counting the nails in the door.
Foot raised, then set down gently.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯照不到我这儿
lines.en: The corridor light does not reach me.
I hold my hook up to the light.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上点了两下
lines.en: My foot taps the floor twice.

lines.zh: 门缝里的风把我的披风吹动
lines.en: Draught through the door stirs my cape.

lines.zh: 我听见走廊那头的响动
lines.en: I hear a sound at the corridor's far end.

lines.zh: 我的头一直歪着，没正过
lines.en: My head stays crooked and never straightens.
My hook throws back a line of light.
I pull my cape up onto my shoulder.
I cock my head further.
My eyes fix on you.
You are too far from the door.
I raise the hook; the knuckles pop.

lines.zh: 你听见我跳的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear my hopping?

lines.zh: 我没有另一只手可以握
lines.en: I have no other hand to offer.
I hop one step forward.

lines.zh: 你的鞋带松了，你都没低头
lines.en: Your lace is loose, and you never looked down.
I cannot smile, but I am watching.
I turn my whole body toward you.

lines.zh: 你站在走廊中间，无处可躲
lines.en: You stand mid-corridor with nowhere to hide.
I lift a foot and hold it in the air.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的钩子下
lines.en: Your shadow lies beneath my hook.
One hop brings me closer.
You should not have walked deeper in.

lines.zh: 我把钩子放低，垂在身侧
lines.en: I lower my hook to my side.
My mouth is open, and silent.

lines.zh: 你数我还有几块完整的壳
lines.en: You are counting my unbroken panels.
Another tear in my cape.
My hook is bent.
I step back against the wall.
A joint cracks.
My eyes dim a little.

lines.zh: 钩子磕在墙上，我吼了一声。
lines.en: My hook scrapes the wall; I snarl.
My hook is bent; I cannot straighten it.
I cannot hop so high now.
I wobble on one hop.
My hook snags the door chain.
I do not eat; I only want to come near.
Put it down and step back.

lines.zh: 我的钩子不适合拿东西
lines.en: My hook is not made for holding things.
I lean in and smell nothing.
You hold it out as if feeding me.
I do not need it, yet I want it.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西不够我一口
lines.en: That little thing is not one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我凑近，钩子碰到你的腕
lines.en: I lean in; my hook meets your wrist.
Step back, and I hop one more.

lines.zh: 那味道让我想起别的什么
lines.en: That smell reminds me of something else.
My hook catches your hem first.

lines.zh: 我的钩子挂到你的衣服
lines.en: My hook catches your clothes.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的披风飞起来
lines.en: We collide and my cape flies up.
I hop half a step away and come back.
My knee finds your middle.
The impact spins you half around.
Your shoulder meets my shell.
My cape tangles your leg.
One hop sends you staggering.
We collide; my hook scrapes the door.

lines.zh: 走廊另一头也有一点光
lines.en: There is another light at the corridor's other end.
We glance at each other.
Her hook is brighter than mine.
We guard front and back.
She pulls a corner of her cape straight.
We hop in the same rhythm.
She waits for me at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 我们两个跳动的声音对上了
lines.en: Our hopping falls into one rhythm.
Her cape is even more torn than mine.

lines.zh: 我们分头守住两个方向
lines.en: We take two directions between us.
I crouch and my hook touches down first.

lines.zh: 我用钩子把东西勾起来
lines.en: I hook the thing up.
My fingers move slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它挂在钩上，晃了晃
lines.en: I hang it on the hook and swing it.
I pick it up, and drop it.

lines.zh: 掉了的东西我捡了三次
lines.en: I picked the fallen thing up three times.
My shell creaks as I bend.
I flick it up with the hook's tip.
Halfway picked up, it falls.

lines.zh: 我把它放在脚边，先记着
lines.en: I set it by my foot to remember.
I stop moving, and my head straightens.
My eyes flare once.

lines.zh: 你听见我停下来的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear me stop?

lines.zh: 我一跳就到了你的前面去
lines.en: One hop puts me right in front of you.
I do not scream; I only watch you.
I stop and raise the hook.
My eyes brighten in the dark.

lines.zh: 我一跳就越过半个走廊
lines.en: One hop crosses half the corridor.
I do not shout; that would spoil it.
I have your position fixed.
I lower my body, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，就是在看我
lines.en: That glance back was at me.
I straighten my head.

lines.zh: 走廊只有一条路，你在我前面
lines.en: There is one path, and you are on it.

lines.zh: 我不着急，从来没人跑掉
lines.en: I am patient; no one has ever escaped.

lines.zh: 我抬起钩子，指节一粒粒响
lines.en: I raise my hook; knuckles crack one by one.
I hop along the corridor wall.
You run; I hop faster.

lines.zh: 我的钩子在墙上刮出线
lines.en: My hook draws a line on the wall.
I will not fall behind by a step.
Look back: I am closer.
I never stop, never.
I follow you hop by hop.
You reach the corner; I do not slow.
My hook stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你跑得越快，我追得越稳。
lines.en: The faster you run, the steadier I follow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跳，声音很轻
lines.en: I hop low, very quietly.

lines.zh: 我跳过一滩水，没有溅起
lines.en: I hop over a puddle without a splash.

lines.zh: 你躲进房间，门挡不住我
lines.en: You hide in a room; a door will not stop me.
I push the door open and enter slowly.
My cape flashes behind the door.
You are counting my hops.
I have come around your flank.
You reach the end; the wall is dead.
My hook swings across.
I hop into your chest.
My fingers clamp your shoulder.
I butt my head into your face.
My foot kicks your knee.

lines.zh: 梦魇的钩子，逼得你贴住墙。
lines.en: Nightmare's hook backs you against the wall.
My hook catches your shoulder.
I leap and land on you.
I butt my forehead into your nose.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你手臂上一抓
lines.en: My fingers rake your arm.
My foot drives into your gut.

lines.zh: 我的钩子划开了你的衣
lines.en: My hook opens your coat.
You block, and I spring away at once.

lines.zh: 我撞在门板上，木头裂了
lines.en: I hit the door and the wood splits.
My leap knocks you down sitting.
My second blow comes from the side.
I hop out from behind the door.

lines.zh: 我的钩子先出现在灯下
lines.en: My hook enters the lamplight first.

lines.zh: 我的披风在门框上挂了一下
lines.en: My cape catches the door frame.
My hook lands first, my feet after.
I cock my head at this corridor.

lines.zh: 走廊的长度我记得很清楚
lines.en: I know this corridor's length well.

lines.zh: 我到了，先看这条走廊有多长
lines.en: I arrive and first measure the corridor.
I land, hook first.

lines.zh: 我的披风在风里飘了一下
lines.en: My cape lifts once in the draught.
I cock my head toward the light.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，不进也不退
lines.en: I stand in the doorway, neither in nor out.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯被我挡了一半
lines.en: I block half the corridor's light.

lines.zh: 我抬起钩子，敲了敲门框
lines.en: I raise my hook and tap the frame.
I hear this house settling.

lines.zh: 我的影子斜在地上很长
lines.en: My shadow lies long on the floor.

lines.zh: 我把脚往前一送，跳进来
lines.en: I push off and hop inside.
I reach this floor first.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，算作招呼
lines.en: I open my mouth widest as a greeting.

lines.zh: 火舔到我的披风，整片烧起来
lines.en: Fire catches my cape and the whole thing burns.
I tumble down the stairs.

lines.zh: 水从我嘴里灌进去，我叫不出声
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth and I cannot cry out.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，钩子飞了
lines.en: The blast flips me and my hook flies off.
My hook hand hangs by the door.

lines.zh: 那股咒力让我的关节僵住
lines.en: The spell stiffens every joint I have.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这副身体在发抖
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet this body trembles.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的钩子上，一路通到手臂
lines.en: Lightning strikes my hook and runs up my arm.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓着门框也掉了
lines.en: No floor; I grab the frame, and fall anyway.
